summary: Ferrari arrives at Monza with a fresh engine upgrade, but Hamilton warns the Scuderia still lacks the complete package needed to challenge for victory at their spiritual home. Red Bull's driver shortage—Hadjar sidelined by wrist injury—creates an opening for McLaren's Norris and Piastri to exploit the power vacuum, especially with questions swirling around their team orders arrangement. A win here would provide Ferrari crucial momentum heading into the season's final stretch, while scorching temperatures threaten to scramble tire strategies and punish any setup miscalculations on the high-speed Monza layout.
